title: Ly sữa ấm
about: Round 36, ke-chuyen-gan ("sáng tác album tiếp theo, album nghe nhẹ nhàng, dễ ngủ"), for a new album, Khẽ khàng, chúc ngủ ngon (Softly, Goodnight): a cup of warm milk before bed, G major in 3/4 at 60 bpm. Its motif settles B-A, G-A-C, B-D, close and warm; the middle in E minor reaches G5. Written to sleep to, gentler than Những giấc mơ nhỏ, on the sound the user kept for sleep (ke-chuyen-gan: the piano near, a wide hall, a soft echo): its tune moves mostly by step and stays low, its sentences come back with small changes, the left hand rocks in eighths through most of it, every section played softer than before (0.24-0.36) and the climax kept low. An original tune.
